It doesn't have any special effects, but it will restore some health.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Swift Carrots are a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. [[Link]] are a can make Roasted Swift Carrots by burning a [[Swift Carrot]] in a [[Fire]] or [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Though they are fragrant, the roasting process removes the special effects of Swift Carrots. Roasted Swift Carrots restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to Link when eaten. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Swift Carrots reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Roasted Swift Carrot]]s to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Though they are fragrant, the roasting process removes the special effects of Swift Carrots. Roasted Swift Carrots restore three-quarters of a [[Heart]] to Link when eaten. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Roasted Endura Carrot * Roasted Food * Swift Carrot }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Carrots, Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
